selection_rule: Hyperparameters and stopping epochs use three train-only temporal folds. Algorithm selected by equal-date validation MAE, before test evaluation. Final fits retain the original train set, without incorporating validation outcomes.
target: Euclidean norm in mm of E,N,Height change from the last observed position on 2014-01-01; not cumulative path length, not the West Wall published target.
quality_rule: Validate source hash; last real reading per sensor/date; consolidate identical duplicates; exclude conflicting timestamps. Keep all finite target values, including large jumps, without treating them as confirmed failure or measurement error. No interpolation or future rain.
prior_exposure: South West has been visualised previously. This is a new model evaluation declared before this run, not an externally preregistered prospective experiment or an independent mine.
primary_contrast: LSTM seed ensemble minus persistence, equal-date MAE in mm; ridge and trend versus persistence are secondary contrasts.
uncertainty_rule: Resample paired calendar losses in moving blocks that never cross missing calendar dates. Report ordinary and Bonferroni intervals for three planned contrasts; sensitivity at block lengths 3,7,14. Treat intervals as exploratory under nonstationary slope response. Seeds are training sensitivity, not independent field samples.
